system.name: RIFT
system.expansion: Rapid parameter Inference on gravitational wave sources via Iterative Fitting

public_sources.supports: RIFT identity, iterative-fitting purpose, validation against LALInference, and use with costly waveform models
GPU translation of parts of RIFT and reported cost/latency acceleration
initial-grid, ILE, CIP, iterative feedback, and convergence-test structure
public_sources.freshness_boundary: Mutable latest-version documentation; recheck at the case freshness date.

public_sources.locator: Basics; Understanding ILE and CIP; Initialization: PSDs and grids; Strongly recommended dependencies
public_sources.supports: HTCondor DAG and submit files, parallel ILE workers, consolidation, CIP/posterior outputs, iteration logs, PSD/grid inputs, and recommended CUDA/CuPy support
public_sources.freshness_boundary: Mutable latest-version documentation; recheck at the case freshness date.

correspondences.public_evidence: RIFT-S3 describes an initial intrinsic grid; RIFT-S4 describes grids, PSDs, configuration, and external dependencies.
correspondences.fixture_analogue: The fixture registers a five-point parameter grid, exact synthetic likelihood-partition identities, and fixed configuration.
correspondences.critical_difference: The fixture has no strain data, PSD, calibration, event configuration, waveform model, or RIFT initialization.

correspondences.public_evidence: RIFT-S4 documents generated ILE/CIP submit files, iteration directories, logs, a top-level DAG, and HTCondor submission.
correspondences.fixture_analogue: The fixture exposes one local make target and a direct Python execution path.
correspondences.critical_difference: The fixture does not construct or execute a RIFT DAG, exercise HTCondor, recover jobs, or inspect scheduler and log lineage.

correspondences.public_evidence: RIFT-S3 and RIFT-S4 describe parallel ILE jobs that evaluate marginalized likelihoods at intrinsic-parameter points.
correspondences.fixture_analogue: Four bundled files contain synthetic log-likelihood values over a common parameter grid.
correspondences.critical_difference: The files are not ILE outputs and the fixture performs no Monte Carlo marginalization or waveform-data comparison.

correspondences.public_evidence: RIFT-S4 describes consolidated composite likelihood files and associated provenance.
correspondences.fixture_analogue: The fixture regenerates a per-partition argmax/log-sum-exp digest and verifies its source digest.
correspondences.critical_difference: The fixture digest is a deliberately small audit example, not a RIFT composite file or production digest algorithm.

correspondences.rift_stage: CIP fitting, posterior sampling, and iterative feedback
correspondences.public_evidence: RIFT-S3 and RIFT-S4 describe fitting ILE training data, drawing posterior samples, and feeding new points into successive iterations.
correspondences.fixture_analogue: The fixture sums synthetic partition likelihoods and normalizes a posterior on a fixed five-point grid.
correspondences.critical_difference: The fixture does not run CIP, fit a likelihood surface, draw posterior samples, adapt a grid, or iterate.

correspondences.public_evidence: RIFT-S3 describes repeated iterations until a convergence test passes; RIFT-S4 lists iteration logs, output grids, and posterior-sample products.
correspondences.fixture_analogue: The fixture checks MAP, central-mass, split-half, source-identity, and corrupted-tail invariants.
correspondences.critical_difference: The fixture invariants are not RIFT convergence diagnostics and establish no production convergence or output-format fidelity.

correspondences.public_evidence: RIFT-S2 reports GPU acceleration; RIFT-S4 strongly recommends CUDA and CuPy and exposes GPU configuration options.
correspondences.fixture_analogue: The resource declaration has separate full-scale and local platform fields.
correspondences.critical_difference: No GPU code ran; numerical equivalence, accelerator configuration, throughput, and resource consumption remain unmeasured.

assessment_mode_effect.reason: Documentary correspondence is not execution, recomputation, attestation, or an independent evidence path.

blocked_assertions: The fixture executes RIFT or reproduces a RIFT result.
The four synthetic partitions are representative of RIFT ILE jobs, events, or production workloads.
The illustrative 8192-partition, GPU-hour, and storage values are measured or sourced RIFT requirements.
RIFT full-scale convergence, scheduler behavior, retries, GPU equivalence, storage integrity, calibration, or scientific conclusions were tested.
Any restricted data, nonpublic workflow, collaboration-internal evidence, or qualified production-domain sign-off was inspected.
next_evidence_gate: Execute a public RIFT example under an independently recorded custody path or obtain qualified domain inspection plus measured resource and lineage evidence; keep any restricted-platform attestation separately governed.
